notes.title: Palladium: Adventure in Greece is now in the Steam store
notes.content:
Hello, everyone!

Yesterday, we finally released the game we've been working on for the last two years. This is a great event for our small team.
Palladium is a first-person 3D quest where you play as an archaeologist who explores an ancient labyrinth. He will have to solve riddles based on myths of ancient Greece. He can do so alone or take one of two possible companions. Each companion has his unique way of solving riddles, so if you finish the game with one companion, you can play again with another.

https://store.steampowered.com/app/1137270/Palladium_Adventure_in_Greece/

To celebrate the release of the game, we decided to make a sale of all our previous games, making the highest discounts we had ever made. The sale will take place on Steam from the 7th to 13th of June 2021. Some of our games have Steam trading cards.

We sincerely hope you will enjoy our games, and especially Palladium: Adventure in Greece!
Please share your opinion about the game on its Steam page. We appreciate all the feedback we can get!

Yours faithfully,
NLB project team

notes.title: Changes in paid DLCs' distribution policies
notes.content:
Hello all!

Recently I was contacted by the Steam support team; they asked me to stop giving away free copies of paid DLCs for Non-Linear Text Quests to those who bought The Barbarian and the Subterranean Caves and/or Return of Red Riding Hood Enhanced Edition. Unfortunately I had to comply with this request.

Let me remind the differences between the game added with this DLC and the standalone version:
[list]
[*] You won't get the corresponding trading cards for the game, to get it you should buy the standalone version instead of this DLC.
[*] You won't get the corresponding achievements for the game, to get it you should buy the standalone version instead of this DLC.
[*] The price of this DLC is less than the price of the standalone version.
[*] The content of the game will be the same as the standalone version.
[/list]

So, if you want to just play the game but you are not interested in the trading cards and achievements, you can consider buying this DLC.

Sorry for the inconvenience,
NLB project team

notes.title: The games “Mansion” and “Another Mars” were added to Non-Linear Text Quests
notes.content:
Hello all!

We’ve added the game “Mansion” to our bundle Non-Linear Text Quests (Russian and Spanish languages are supported at this moment).

This game is hardcore quest with lots of difficult puzzles. Help Ivan to find his younger brother, who disappeared in a strange abandoned mansion.

[img]https://steamcdn-a.akamaihd.net/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/32926472/d1d75eaf98d3ac3e6189d12e2d18d40c6d58941c.png[/img]

Game controls resembles classic point and click quests: you select the action verb and click on the object. You can also perform actions with the help of inventory items.

Also we've added brand new game "Another Mars" by Peter Kosyh. It is parser text adventure, where you assume the role of the "Mars One" mission astronaut (the game is in Russian at this moment).

[img]https://steamcdn-a.akamaihd.net/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/32926472/7c6a49f2000b0340fe8b47d402c903223c100638.png[/img]

These game are located in the Community games catalogue of Non-Linear Text Quests. To launch these games, please follow the steps below:
[list]
[*] Select desired launcher UI language in the correct catalogue (Community games)
[*] From the list on the left, select the game you want to play"
[*] On the game page, click "Download". The game download process will be started, please wait.
[*] Click "Start" to launch the game
[/list]

[img]https://steamcdn-a.akamaihd.net/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/32926472/632c2b146f64f09a588b128ec5932a6e282d0c82.png[/img]

notes.title: Release date change
notes.content:
Hello all!

Unfortunately, we should slightly change the release date of the game due to the technical problems in the Windows build which were discovered at the last day before release.

The game should run fine on the most systems as is, and the correction is very simple, but it will take a couple of business days to implement and test it, both on our side and on side of the Valve.

The game will be released as soon as everything will be ready on both sides, sorry for the inconvenience!

Best regards,
Anton & NLB project team.
